title: Pforzheim Tricuspid Valve Registry - Outcomes of Percutaneous Tricuspid Valve Repair
official: Pforzheim Tricuspid Valve Registry: A Real-world Observational Trial Evaluating Outcomes in Patients Treated With the Abbott TriClip™ Device in Helios Klinikum Pforzheim
summary: The Pforzheim Tricuspid Valve Registry study is designed to confirm the safety and performance of the TriClip™ device in a contemporary real-world setting in critically ill patients. The observational trial is a prospective, single arm, open-label, single-center, post market registry.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects (\>=18 years age) have severe tricuspid regurgitation and are symptomatic despite medical therapy.
* Subjects eligible to receive the TriClip™
* Subjects must provide written informed consent prior to study procedure.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects participating in another clinical study that may impact the follow-up or results of this study.
